error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 此数据库没有兼容的部署记录，请使用与现有数据匹配的程序；若另一节点正在首次初始化数据库，请等其完成后重启。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: This database has no compatible deployment record. Use the application matching the existing data. If another node is initializing the database, wait for it to finish and restart.

error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 数据库缺少必要的企业或初始化记录，请先恢复完整备份。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: Required organization or initialization records are missing. Restore a complete backup first.

error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 部署记录不完整，请恢复原部署记录，不能重新选择初始化企业。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: The deployment record is incomplete. Restore the original record; do not select another initial organization.

error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 此数据库与当前安装包不兼容，请使用与现有部署匹配的程序启动；已有数据未修改。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: This database is incompatible with the installed package. Start the application matching the existing deployment. Existing data was not changed.

error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 数据库已经包含业务数据，但缺少完整的初始化部署关系，请恢复完整的部署记录或备份。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: The database contains business data but has incomplete initial deployment relationships. Restore the complete deployment record or a backup.

error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 保存的部署编号格式不正确，请恢复原部署记录。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: The saved deployment ID format is invalid. Restore the original deployment record.

error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 社区版只支持初始化时建立的企业，当前数据库的企业或初始化记录不一致。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: The community edition supports only the organization created during initialization. This database's organization or initialization records are inconsistent.

error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.zh-CN: 无法检查数据库所属版本，应用启动已停止。
error.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.en: The database edition could not be checked. Application startup was stopped.

error.edition.installationService.lockBe.zh-CN: 当前数据库已有企业但初始化记录不完整，请先恢复完整的部署记录或备份。
error.edition.installationService.lockBe.en: The database contains organizations but has incomplete initialization records. Restore complete deployment records or a backup first.

error.edition.installationService.requir.zh-CN: 初始企业必须由首次初始化的管理员创建。
error.edition.installationService.requir.en: The initial organization must be created by the administrator performing first-time initialization.

error.edition.installationService.record.zh-CN: 首次初始化必须在同一事务中创建且只创建一个企业
error.edition.installationService.record.en: First-time initialization must create exactly one organization in the same transaction.

error.edition.installationService.record.zh-CN: 部署记录已经变化，首次初始化未提交
error.edition.installationService.record.en: The deployment record changed. First-time initialization was not committed.

error.edition.installationService.requir.zh-CN: 部署记录不完整，请联系管理员恢复备份。
error.edition.installationService.requir.en: The deployment record is incomplete. Contact an administrator to restore a backup.

error.edition.installationService.requir.zh-CN: 数据库与当前安装版本不一致，请使用与现有部署匹配的程序启动。
error.edition.installationService.requir.en: The database does not match the installed edition. Start the application matching the existing deployment.

error.edition.singleEnterprisePolicy.req.zh-CN: 社区版只支持初始化时创建的企业。
error.edition.singleEnterprisePolicy.req.en: The community edition supports only the organization created during initialization.

log.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.f.zh-CN: 启动前无法建立部署检查所需的数据库映射
log.edition.communityDatabasePreflight.f.en: Could not initialize database mappings for deployment checks before startup
